summary: Amber International Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 28, 2026, reporting its first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The press release details a decline in total revenue to US$10.0 million, a non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA loss of US$3.2 million, and strategic updates including the launch of A-MM and a planned C4AI Investor Day. There are no terms of a special situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or going-private. The filing is a routine earnings report and does not trigger a special-situations classification.
